metadata.geometry: Consecutive directed OpenStreetMap street/path vertices; routes return to their start.
metadata.coverage: Full sample roster and workload counts; geography limited to the downloaded source bounds.

metadata.limitations: Greedy heuristic, fixed speed and service time, conservative mapped access, not legal clearance, live traffic or certified navigation.
